why: A member whose paragraph contains the first-reading formula still becomes the speaker; the formula line only counts when it is not a labelled speech.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr A: Hello there.

Mr B: Sir, this Bill was presented by the Minister for Law in March and read a first time then; I support it.

My second paragraph.
expected_rows: Sir, this Bill was presented by the Minister for Law in March and read a first time then; I support it.
